claimBoundary.hookProfile: The constructor-sealed development reference has an independent functional-conformance PASS for same-transaction frozen-target enforcement on the pinned T-REX implementation.
claimBoundary.native: The published Native runtime is byte-exact. The new model source does not automatically renew the previous model-to-runtime mapping.
claimBoundary.partial: The published ERC-3643 Partial source and runtime are byte-exact and retain full=false.
claimBoundary.refinement: mapped implementation evidence; end-to-end refinement incomplete

obligations.abstractCondition: The Full development profile starts from a complete fresh regulatory state rather than a selected import manifest.
obligations.finalSourceConsumer: implementation/src/profiles/ERC3643HookDeployment.sol: TOKEN_CREATION_HASH check and constructor-owned deployment sequence
obligations.compiledConsumer: evidence/trust12/runtime-identity.json and the separately compiled actual T-REX artifact
obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: The creation-code pin proves the exact source initialization path. Runtime identity alone cannot prove storage completeness; no deployed instance is claimed.

obligations.abstractCondition: The public factory admits only the final HookAdapter creation code and supplies the constructor arguments itself.
obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: Direct deployment of the same exact endpoint creation code is also a fresh supported construction. The factory is not a deployment receipt.

obligations.abstractCondition: The exact fresh construction leaves the endpoint as the sole token Agent and the inert governor as owner.
obligations.normativeReceiver: docs/PROFILES.md: no raw Agent or owner administration path
obligations.finalSourceConsumer: implementation/src/profiles/ERC3643HookDeployment.sol: one addAgent call and transferOwnership to ERC3643HookGovernor
obligations.compiledConsumer: The HookAdapter creation code pinned by evidence/trust12/runtime-identity.json contains the construction sequence.
obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: The stock T-REX Agent mapping is not enumerable. Completeness comes from exact fresh creation code and its only Agent write, not from a live agent-count view.

obligations.abstractCondition: Every actual balance callback materialises min(owned frozen target, actual balance) before the token operation returns.
obligations.compiledConsumer: Actual T-REX transfer, transferFrom, batch transfer and forced-transfer callbacks execute the HookAdapter runtime.
obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: This is evidence for the pinned T-REX callback order and fixed profile. It is not a claim about every ERC-3643 implementation.

obligations.abstractCondition: Only the immutable Compliance bound to the token may invoke the balance-change callback.
obligations.normativeReceiver: The hook cannot be an unauthenticated state-changing entrypoint.
obligations.compiledConsumer: HookAdapter runtime plus exact Compliance and token immutable addresses
obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: The callback can only move upstream frozen amounts toward adapter-owned targets; it cannot create a TRUST command.

obligations.abstractCondition: A failed post-balance callback reverts the token balance, allowance and emitted effects in the same transaction.
obligations.normativeReceiver: Failure during same-transaction enforcement cannot leave a partial transfer.
obligations.finalSourceConsumer: Pinned T-REX transferFrom calls Compliance after its tentative balance update; EVM reversion restores the call frame.
obligations.consumerRemovalNegative: The test injects the failing callback and requires exact balance and allowance stutter before a successful recovery transfer.
obligations.compiledConsumer: Actual T-REX 4.1.3 bytecode under the CANCUN execution schedule
obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: Correct EVM transaction rollback under the named schedule remains in the trusted execution semantics.

obligations.abstractCondition: The receipt preimage consumes actual upstream restriction values for every observed role.
obligations.normativeReceiver: docs/PROFILES.md: actual restriction post-state and receipt equality
obligations.compiledConsumer: HookAdapter receipt storage and final RegulatoryActionApplied event
obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: The receipt commits to the observed value. It does not prove the external legal truth of that restriction.

obligations.abstractCondition: The explicit native abstract initial state satisfies finite balance, empty case, custody and reference consistency.
obligations.consumerRemovalNegative: The historical model canary demonstrated the earlier self-transfer and inactive-custody mismatches before they were corrected.
obligations.compiledConsumer: None. Constructor storage decoding and initialization refinement remain open.
obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: This is an abstract model initial state, not a theorem about a deployed constructor.

obligations.abstractCondition: An admitted ordinary transfer preserves finite supply accounting, custody backing and custody/case references.
obligations.positiveActivation: The theorem is included in the TRUST12_Accounting_Obstruction child session and its 12-root oracle audit.
obligations.consumerRemovalNegative: The pre-repair self-transfer canary proved that the former non-sequential move_balance increased the abstract balance.
obligations.compiledConsumer: None. A checked EVM word-update correspondence remains open.
obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: Source and destination must be in the finite support. The theorem does not cover regulatory forward or reversal steps.

obligations.abstractCondition: Every admitted forward and reversal preserves a structural state invariant strong enough to relate overlay heads, actions, cases and custody.
obligations.finalSourceConsumer: No final structural invariant or full preservation theorem yet.
obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: The typed obstruction state is ill formed and is not claimed reachable from native_initial_state.

obligations.abstractCondition: Successive executions connect each post-state to the next pre-state and preserve success and failure outcomes in a typed trace.
obligations.normativeReceiver: Wave 3 run-level relation and result tracking
obligations.consumerRemovalNegative: Pending removal of one state-link or outcome observation
obligations.assumptionsNonclaims: A theorem that assumes runtime_link at every step would remain conditional.
